rootCauseSummary: Tenant DNA loads and activates, but the earliest structural defect is design-evidence navigation capture storing a flat sibling list (service links as level-1 isDropdown items without nested children). Site-chrome navigation then promotes footer utility links into header primary nav and collapses services into a dropdown—outputs that never existed in the source header DOM. Footer background was captured as #ffffff in design-evidence while live source footer is teal (#01424a in brand DNA). Colour tokens prefer captured evidence header text (#767676) over brand DNA headerText (#01424a). Validation reports navigation 0% because the source WordPress nav uses nested ul.nav.navbar-nav (labels not readable by primaryNavLabels child-walk) and image-slot 25% because lazy below-fold images report naturalWidth=0 during headless capture despite correct HTML assignments.
firstIncorrectDecision: design-evidence navigation.items captured as flat level-1 siblings (Flu Vaccine…Diabetes marked isDropdown:true without nesting under All Services children[])
firstIncorrectFunction: navigation hierarchy flattening at design-evidence capture (header.navItems / navigation.items writer)

failureTypes.navigation: incorrect source evidence structure + correct evidence but wrong renderer selection (footer utility promotion into header) + validation selector mismatch (Bootstrap ul.nav.navbar-nav vs nav.nav-links primaryNavLabels)
failureTypes.header: geometry/CTA placement divergence (CTA outside nav in .nav-cta-group), top bar injected, header text colour evidence override (#767676 vs brand #01424a)
failureTypes.footer: footer background capture error (#ffffff in evidence vs #01424a rendered), strict footer omits hours/contact blocks present on source, generic social URLs
failureTypes.colour: design-evidence footer.backgroundColour #ffffff + header text #767676 preferred over brand-dna semanticColours
failureTypes.image: validation lazy-load false negative (3/4 slots naturalWidth=0 in headless); source page lacks data-image-slot attributes
failureTypes.responsive: downstream of header/nav/footer chrome mismatches across desktop/tablet/mobile; mobile stacked-nav vs source Bootstrap collapse
